positive_stage_translation.note: For a positive +2-stage attribute boost, the first stage contributes the full R and the second stage contributes 25% of that first-stage contribution. No +3-stage rule is introduced here.

rules.increase_or_slowdown: multiplier = 1 + effective_positive_stage_weight * R for positive attribute boosts
rules.reduction_or_speedup: legacy reduction/debuff curve remains unchanged unless a separate rule explicitly replaces it

notes: Every additional finite Status point remains useful.
Positive +2-stage boosts are translated centrally to 1.25x instead of being doubled per move.
The rule is global for the central stat-modifier runtime and therefore applies to current and future moves that use the shared stage mechanic.
Existing negative -2 debuffs are not silently redesigned by this change.
Horter/Stockpile uses the same +2 translation per stack but stores one persistent Defense contribution instead of multiplying temporary modifiers.
Weather does not use this rule; weather strength and effects belong to the central weather definition.
